blocks.text: CABANATUAN CITY, NUEVA ECIJA, Philippines — A 35-year-old woman was nabbed with 13 pieces of alleged fake P1,000 bills after an attempt to use one in purchasing dressed chicken inside a public market in Barangay San Isidro here on Wednesday. Police Lt. Col. Lester Zafra, city police chief, said a female vendor, a 54- resident of Barangay Magsaysay Norte in this city, sought the help of market officials upon noticing that the money handed to her by the suspect was not genuine. “Biniro pa niya (victim) na parang peke itong pera mo.
